description.value: Browne Creek Wetlands is a nature reserve situated within the Vedder Greenway along the south bank of the Vedder River in Chilliwack. The area centres on a salmon spawning channel network constructed by Fisheries and Oceans Canada and the Fraser Valley Watersheds Coalition, with trail infrastructure developed through a partnership between the City of Chilliwack and the Rotary Club of Chilliwack. Its location within the Vedder Greenway corridor makes it a natural detour point for cyclists riding the greenway route.
